DNR: mechanism is a reciprocal-broadcast arithmetic change with no vectorization or launch-geometry mutation, so it does not match dnr-q8-vec4-quantizer or dnr-q8-workgroup128-exact-replay fingerprints and supplies the new discriminator required by akh-v2-q8-quantizer-new-mechanism. Semantics: after warp_reduce_max<QK8_1>, amax is uniform per 32-lane group, so broadcasting id from src_lane = lane & ~(QK8_1-1) is correct under either warp-size convention (WARP_SIZE=32: width-32 sub-group relative lane 0; WARP_SIZE=64: absolute lanes 0/32 are exactly the iqs==0 lanes). The amax==0 path still yields q=0 via id=0, avoiding division by zero; reciprocal ulp error cannot exceed the int8 range (would need ~0.4% relative error to flip 127 to 128). Early-exit lanes cannot orphan a reader because i0 is monotone in lane index within a group. HIP maps __shfl_sync to __shfl and ignores the 32-bit mask, so the intrinsic is valid for this gfx90a/HIP campaign. Residual risk, handled by the pipeline rather than blocking: (1) xi*(1/d) may differ from xi/d by ±1 int8 at exact-half rounding boundaries; the 1139-case MUL_MAT correctness gate and the stop-on-mismatch rule adjudicate this. (2) Expected gain is modest: on a SIMD wave the ternary does not skip the masked reciprocal and the shuffle adds latency in a likely memory-bound kernel, so the exact-duration falsifier may well fire; that is the declared falsifier ("Exact quantizer duration does not improve") and the governed screen with min_replication_effect 0.125% / nomination floor 0.5% is the correct instrument to decide it. Falsifier, decision policy, and frame binding are all present and consistent with the portfolio record.

critic.reason: The multiply-and-mask qh extraction is not equivalence-preserving because vh[i] is not masked to its low nibble before the multiply. With multiplier 0x02040810 (bits 4,11,18,25) and mask 0x10101010 (bits 4,12,20,28), product bit 12 receives contributions from source bit 1 (intended) AND source bit 8 (unintended, via the +4 shift term), and analogous collisions hit bits 20 (from source bits 9,16) and 28 (from source bits 10,17,24), plus potential carries from unmasked positions. Counterexample: vh_i=0x100 gives 0x100*0x02040810=0x04081000, &0x10101010=0x00001000 (bit 12 set) whereas the original code yields 0. Since vh[i]=qh>>(4*(iqs+i)) retains the full remaining qh word, those higher bits carry real quant data, so decoded values are corrupted on essentially every Q5_0 block and the candidate will fail the 1139-case MUL_MAT correctness stage, wasting one of the three declared candidate slots. Required revision: mask each operand to 4 bits, i.e. qh0=((vh_i & 0x0F)*0x02040810u)&0x10101010u and qh1=(((vh_i>>16)&0x0F)*0x02040810u)&0x10101010u; with bits 0-3 only, all partial products land on distinct bit positions with no carries and the result exactly matches the original scatter (bit0->4, bit1->12, bit2->20, bit3->28). Everything else is sound: the loop hoist of get_int_b2(bq5_0->qh,0)>>(4*iqs) in vec_dot_q5_0_q8_1 composes correctly under arithmetic shift; the patch stays within cuda-vecdotq-v1 declared files/symbols; it is an arithmetic, non-wave-count mechanism that does not match dnr-q5-four-wave or any other DNR fingerprint; and expected_dispatch correctly reproduces the three sealed true/true type-6 anchors while excluding the 129-call false/true tail. Resubmit with the nibble masks added (and re-verify the impl also stays correct for the MMQ vdr=4 instantiation, which shares this helper).
